score_boundary: Scores are analyst screening judgements, not benchmarks. Adoption 0 means no qualifying dependent/download measurement in the inspected evidence, NOT zero users. Health is conservative: recent activity can earn 3 but issue-response time and bus factor are unmeasured. No aggregate score treats unknown adoption as a demonstrated quality defect. ADOPT means preferred for a conditional design, not installed, licensed for a final distribution, security-qualified or accepted by NM.

taxonomy_gaps.reason: Native DAW state, plug-in dependency and render fidelity are richer than generic serialisation.
Synthesis, transcription, separation and musical analysis are not merely codecs.
Composition/master shares, CWR/territory identifiers and royalty statements carry domain-specific authority.
OSC, Link and network audio are not WebSocket; this is an explicit nearest-tag mapping, not a protocol claim.
